common_rule: recipient allowlist, supported rail, exact quote fits maximum service budget; modeled authorization is never executable
simple_policy: common rule plus identity, quote validity and declared value greater than quoted cost
cheap_preflight: simple policy plus predeclared reachability, output-schema and latency-bound probes
full_paid_radar: common rule plus unchanged canonical judgment; sufficient evidence and confidence >= 80, all hard vetoes retained
optimization: stage simple and cheap reject-only filters before unchanged full Radar; never promote a block or abstention
decision_rule_tuning: none; no threshold search or holdout-trained selection
uncertainty: descriptive finite synthetic sets; no population confidence interval, causal market effect or independent external truth
multiple_comparisons: all grid rows reported, no held-out significance claims; any future tuning requires new holdout
